name: MongoDB High Availability
description: MongoDB replica set with automatic elections
readme:
# MongoDB High Availability

Companion template used to convert an existing MongoDB service (`haTemplateCode` of the `mongo` template). It is not deployed on its own.

- **root**: the existing service is restarted with `--replSet` and initiates the replica set. Its data is kept.
- **replica**: secondaries that initial-sync from the primary. MongoDB elects a new primary on its own when the primary fails.

There is no proxy tier: MongoDB drivers discover the primary themselves. After conversion the root's `MONGO_URL` lists every member with `replicaSet=rs0`, so `${{<root>.MONGO_URL}}` keeps working.

services.name: mongo

haConversionConfig.description: MongoDB replica set. 구성원 과반수가 투표로 새 주 노드를 뽑습니다(노드 전체 수는 홀수).

replica.label: Secondary
replica.description: 주 노드에서 복제하는 secondary입니다. 짝수로 골라 투표 수를 홀수로 유지합니다.

services.start_command:
set -eu
KEY=/tmp/keel-ha-mongo.key
( umask 077; printf '%s' "$KEEL_HA_KEYFILE" > "$KEY" )
chown mongodb:mongodb "$KEY" 2>/dev/null || chown 999:999 "$KEY"
chmod 400 "$KEY"
exec docker-entrypoint.sh mongod --replSet "${KEEL_HA_REPLSET:-rs0}" --keyFile "$KEY" --bind_ip_all
